name: xneon-launcher
description: Modern, fast, and feature-rich Minecraft launcher

scripts.dev:bundled: bun run build:dev && bun scripts/electrobun.mjs run --env=dev
scripts.dev:share: bun --bun run concurrently -k -s first "bun run share:server" "bun --bun run cross-env XNLC_SHARE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8787 bun run dev"
scripts.build:share: bun run --filter @xnlc/archives build && bun run --filter @xnlc/share build && bun run --filter @xnlc/types build
scripts.build: bun run prepare:desktop && bun run typecheck && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:workers && bun scripts/electrobun.mjs build --env=stable
scripts.typecheck: bun --bun run tsc --noEmit && bun --bun run tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.share:worker:dev: bun run build:share && bun x wrangler@4.160.0 dev --config infrastructure/xnlc-share/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.share:worker:deploy: bun run build:share && bun x wrangler@4.160.0 deploy --config infrastructure/xnlc-share/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.share:test: bun run --filter @xnlc/archives build && bun run --filter @xnlc/share test && bun test infrastructure/xnlc-share/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.prepare:desktop: bun scripts/electrobun.mjs prepare && bun scripts/gen-credentials.mjs && bun scripts/gen-agent-ipc-catalog.mjs && bun run --filter "@xnlc/*" build
scripts.build:dev: bun run prepare:desktop && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:workers && bun scripts/electrobun.mjs build --env=dev
scripts.build:canary: bun run prepare:desktop && bun run typecheck && bun run build:renderer && bun run build:workers && bun scripts/electrobun.mjs build --env=canary
scripts.test:prepare: bun scripts/electrobun.mjs prepare && bun scripts/gen-credentials.mjs && bun scripts/gen-agent-ipc-catalog.mjs && bun run --filter "@xnlc/*" build && bun scripts/build-electrobun-tests.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: bun run test:prepare && bun test tests/electrobun
scripts.test:parser: bun run --filter @xnlc/archives build && bun run --filter @xnlc/parser build && bun scripts/test-parser.mjs offline
scripts.test:integration: bun run test:prepare && bun scripts/test-parser.mjs integration
scripts.test:archives: bun run --filter @xnlc/archives build && bun test packages/xnlc-archives/tests
scripts.test:security: bun run test:prepare && bun test tests/security tests/agent
scripts.test:offline: bun run test:prepare && bun run test:offline:prepared
